structured_output.describe: A painted woman in a white cap and apron stands at the foot of a wooden staircase, holding a lit candlestick in one hand and a round wooden tray of about five stemmed glasses in the other, while her large shadow falls across the wall to the right.

contradictions.what: The words say she 'climbed the stairs,' but she is standing still and facing the viewer, not mid-ascent; the stairs are behind and beside her rather than under her feet.

The cast shadow on the right wall is a head-and-shoulders silhouette in profile facing left, while she faces the viewer, so the shadow does not match her pose and could read as a second, unnamed presence; the words mention only Rosa and her absent master.
